# Order brief — Riverside 5K volunteer shirts
Taken by: Sam (front desk), phone call with Dana Whitfield on Mar 1, 2026

- Product: Gildan 64000 Softstyle unisex tee
- Quantity: 120
- Sizes: S 20 / M 40 / L 40 / XL 15 / 2XL 5
- Garment color: Navy
- Print: front center, 11" wide, screen print
- Ink colors: 2 — white + safety orange
- Front text: "RIVERSIDE 5K FUN RUN 2026" / "Saturday, May 16" / "riverside5k.org"
- Price: $9.50 per shirt (2-color front) — total $1,140.00
- Needed by: pickup in store Saturday May 9, 2026

sources.text:
Hi Sam! Confirming the 120 navy shirts for the fun run, final design attached (front.png).
Any chance we can do $8.50 a shirt like last year?

Small change! Registrations jumped so we need 150 shirts now — please add the 30 extra as mediums.
Also the race moved to SUNDAY May 17 because of the park permit. Everything else stays the same.
